item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: President Trump is in China for a meeting with its leader and Russia's Putin, Nvidia holds first earning call since CEO's resignation, concerns grow after ongoing tech outages nationwide.
item.content:encoded: President Trump is in China for a meeting with its leader and Russia's Putin, Nvidia holds first earning call since CEO's resignation, concerns grow after ongoing tech outages nationwide.
item.dc:creator: A Martínez

item.title: Rubio says there's 'zero' information that U.S. outages are caused by a malign actor
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio sought to calm Americans as he traveled with President Trump and they prepared for key meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
item.content:encoded:
Secretary of State Marco Rubio sought to calm Americans as he traveled with President Trump and they prepared for key meetings with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

(Image credit: Aaron Favila)

item.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat into Democrats' column
item.description: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has narrowly won Alaska's U.S. Senate race, toppling the Republican incumbent, according to a race call by The Associated Press.
item.content:encoded:
Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has narrowly won Alaska's U.S. Senate race, toppling the Republican incumbent, according to a race call by The Associated Press.

item.title: Iran launches a third round of strikes on Bahrain, host of U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet
item.description: Iran fired drones on Tuesday at a U.S. radar facility in Bahrain, and the U.S. retaliated by firing at Iranian targets along an important shipping route.
item.content:encoded:
Iran fired drones on Tuesday at a U.S. radar facility in Bahrain, and the U.S. retaliated by firing at Iranian targets along an important shipping route.

(Image credit: Vahid Salemi)

item.title: Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
item.description: The former Nvidia CEO said he would be "honored" to return if the board allowed. But the board says it has no intention of reinstating him.
item.content:encoded:
The former Nvidia CEO said he would be "honored" to return if the board allowed. But the board says it has no intention of reinstating him.

(Image credit: Benjamin Fanjoy)
item.dc:creator: Shannon Bond

item.title: Trump is in Asia ahead of Xi, Putin summit. And, tech leaders want Huang back at Nvidia
item.description: Trump says he plans to discuss Ukraine during his Asia trip, which contradicts what the White House previously announced. And, Silicon Valley leaders are pushing for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.
item.content:encoded:
Trump says he plans to discuss Ukraine during his Asia trip, which contradicts what the White House previously announced. And, Silicon Valley leaders are pushing for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia.

item.title: Sen. Jack Reed says FAA needs a real plan, not just more money
item.description: Sen. Jack Reed raised concerns about FAA oversight of contractors after last week's nationwide ground stop and criticized the Trump administration's request for $50 billion in additional funding.

item.description: In late October, Google had the worst stock day in its history as a public company. The Planet Money newsletter asks: has Google been caught in "the innovator's dilemma"?

item.title: I'm a human doctor with human intelligence. But I sure do like my AI notetaker
item.description: Has your doctor asked whether they can use artificial intelligence to take notes during an exam? It's very popular, and here's how to think through the pros and the cons of the new technology.

item.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
item.description: Manila is President Trump's first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
